title: A fundamental principle of aeronautical engineering has been overturned
summary: A Wired article reporting that researchers have overturned a long-held fundamental principle in aeronautical engineering, potentially revolutionizing aircraft design and aerodynamics understanding.
problem_solved: Challenges a previously accepted scientific principle that governed how aircraft are designed and built.
why_valuable: This discovery could lead to more efficient aircraft designs, improved fuel economy, and better understanding of airflow behavior around aircraft surfaces.
